sample_unit: LLM responses to prostate cancer consult notes

links.outcome: Guideline-discordant and potentially harmful recommendations associated with reasoning errors in oncology
links.effect: Reasoning errors occurred in 23 percent of interpretations; reasoning failures were associated with guideline-discordant and potentially harmful recommendations, particularly in advanced disease management.
links.quote: Reasoning failures were associated with guideline-discordant and potentially harmful recommendations, particularly in advanced disease management.

unlisted_practices: Taxonomy of LLM reasoning errors mapped to cognitive bias frameworks for evaluating reasoning fidelity
Automated LLM-based evaluators (LLM-as-judge) for detecting reasoning errors

screen.reason: Retrospective simulation evaluating safety and cognitive reasoning errors (bias) in LLM-generated chains of thought for clinical oncology notes.
